title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU

summary: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU.
takeaways: A VIO filter publishes metric poses, a depth foundation model conditioned on them predicts depth for short keyframe windows, and a factor graph fuses the resulting submaps.
We evaluate a single mapping configuration across five public camera-IMU setups and a new Phone-rig/GoPro dataset.
We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU.
